Package com.example.eventlottery.domain

Class UserProfile

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventlottery.domain.UserProfile
public class UserProfile extends Object
Represents a user profile in the application. Stores personal information, role, notification preferences, and whether the required profile info has been completed. User stories supported: - US 01.02.01: Provide personal info - US 01.02.02: Update personal info - US 01.02.03: View event history - US 01.02.04: Delete profile - US 01.04.03: Opt out of notifications - US 01.07.01: Be identified by device
Version:
1.2
Author:
Dmitriy Limanets, Fawaz Mansoor, Kenneth Joseph

    • UserProfile

      public UserProfile()
      Empty constructor required by Firestore to deserialize documents.

    • UserProfile

      public UserProfile(String deviceId, String name, String email, String phoneNumber)
      Creates a user profile with default role "entrant". A user can exist by device ID even if their profile info is incomplete.
      Parameters:
      deviceId - unique device identifier
      name - user's name
      email - user's email
      phoneNumber - user's phone number (optional)

      email - user's email
      phoneNumber - user's phone number (optional)
      role - user's role
